author: BlockUnmasked
text: FBI and U.S. Secret Service alleged North Korean TraderTraitor hackers stole more than $6.3 billion from Binance last week.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Ivanti Connect Secure: active exploitation confirmed (CVE-2026-104935). Upgrade immediately and perform memory and network forensics if compromise is suspected.

author: ManiarViral
text: Malicious npm packages steal GITHUB_TOKEN, AWS keys, KUBECONFIG, VAULT_TOKEN via preinstall hooks before your code runs. If it hit your CI or dev machine, assume breach.

author: HeyImMrMeeseeks
text: A VMware ESX logging flaw (CVE-2026-41709) was exploited as a zero-day by WARP PANDA against legal targets. Patch ESX per VMSA-2026-0006.

author: threatroundup
text: Cloud platform Northflank says assume all environment variables were decrypted after a breach Wiz flagged Oct. 30. Customers report stolen AI API keys being abused (LLMjacking). Via BleepingComputer.

author: CriminalIP_US
text: Nextcloud Document Editing App Becomes an Entry Point: Actively Exploited Collabora RCE. Attackers have exploited CVE-2026-110447 in Nextcloud's Built-in CODE Server app to deploy web shells and search for sensitive files.

author: a13xp0p0v
text: Dangerous Device: Exploiting CVE-2026-31695 in the Linux Kernel via struct device. A stable PoC exploit for a race condition caused by a logical bug in network device management.

author: dailytechonx
text: Langflow versions 1.0.0-1.12.8 contain critical Remote Code Execution flaws and auth bypass holes. CVE-2026-93680 and CVE-2026-110186 let unauthenticated attackers run code. Auto-login default setting amplifies risk. Patch to 1.13.0.

author: rav4nn
text: An MCP tool could let strangers write to your server. JFrog disclosed CVE-2026-120338 on 1 Nov. It scores 10.0 out of 10 and hits Prefab UI's Generative UI sandbox, where a model writes Python that draws a live screen.

author: FLINTKYA
text: Between October 26 and 28, GitHub's advisory database published 112 malware advisories covering 106 npm and PyPI packages.

author: ZeroDayFacts
text: Ivanti has patched two additional Connect Secure vulnerabilities chained with an authentication bypass flaw in zero-day attacks targeting remote access gateways since at least October 1, 2026.

author: wahlbang07
text: CVE-2026-98432: Red Hat rates it Critical (CVSS 9.8). Anthropic used Claude to demonstrate unauthenticated root RCE on a vulnerable Linux MPTCP listener. Serious, but exposure depends on configuration.

author: Orion84x
text: Ivanti's second Connect Secure zero-day is confirmed exploited: chained with an auth bypass for root. No malware dropped, logs wiped, integrity scan clean. Gateways on 22.8R2.4 are in scope - patch and rotate.

author: CERT_UG
text: Patch Now | Nov 2. Drupal Commerce Core (CVE-2026-118539): active attacks, 42,000+ stores exposed. Ivanti Connect Secure: 3 flaws chained to unauthenticated root. Cisco ASA/FTD (CVE-2026-76418): unauth firewall crash, exploited.

author: ApollonVisual
text: Polymarket Reimburses $2.7 Million After Cyberattack. Polymarket confirmed a security incident affecting 726 customer wallets following a malicious script attack on 29 October 2026 via a third-party website monitoring provider.

author: f1tym1
text: Security researchers have released technical details and a working proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit for CVE-2026-31419, a high-severity Linux kernel vulnerability.

author: _pksharma
text: A person gets in. An AI agent does the long middle. A person comes back to detonate. That is how Sophos says the Aur0ra ransomware crew worked (Sophos CTU, 29 October).

author: shawmakesmagic
text: Just got a bill from Together AI for $2,433.37. My API key was compromised in the Railway hack and used to run DeepSeek and GLM-5.3.

author: rohanpaul_ai
text: In Epoch AI tests, Z.ai's open-weight GLM 5.3 turned unshipped Firefox security fixes into working attacks (i.e. built working exploits) on 6 consecutive releases.

author: aseemjakhar
text: PHP2Shell: two decade-old PHP bugs (CVE-2026-109618/109619) allow unauthenticated RCE with a single web request. AI helped build the exploit in about a week. Threat actors struck 4 days before a patch existed. Patch now: 8.5.12 / 8.4.27 / 8.3.36 / 8.2.35

author: Python_s_
text: WAVLINK Router WireGuard Management Handler Has Public Command-Injection PoC. WAVLINK WN536AX6-A, CVE-2026-120280, CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1: 10.0).

author: lee1981b
text: CVE-2026-112816 - LXD / MicroCloud: a public certificate becomes a trusted management identity. Canonical CNA: Critical, CVSS v4.0 10.0, CWE-295.

author: rtehrani
text: LiteLLM’s October 2026 supply-chain breach began months before attackers published a poisoned package. An administrative key committed to a public repository in May was later deleted from view, but it remained valid. Attackers eventually used that credential to obtain a GitHub

text: Over 11,300 GitLab instances are vulnerable to CVE-2026-110264, and over 1,000 to the actively exploited CVE-2026-97229. Patch now. dlvr.​it/TW8Yvf #Security #CISA #DevOps #GitLab #Patches - Follow for more https://t.co/tR6LtBIWF2

author: dailytechonx
text: Security alert: the BeyondTrust Remote Support vulnerability CVE-2026-102764, rated critical (9.3), is once again under active scanning. Probes from Hong Kong are mimicking Metasploit-style traffic against POST /api/start_session on versions 26.2.3 and earlier. Armory Castle’s https://t.co/Jue3yPixfe

author: DuckButTurttle
text: TightVNC Viewer 2.8.88 has a pre-auth RCE with a public PoC, no CVE: a malicious VNC server, or anyone reaching a viewer in Listening Mode on TCP 5500, gets code execution. Fixed in 2.8.89+ and 4.0.2; not exploited. Source: SSD Secure Disclosure https://t.co/SWhjdPWJJT

author: SpectraAudit
text: VOLTA: When Infostealers Use AI to Identify High-Value Victims. A newly discovered Windows infostealer, VOLTA-AUTODOXER, steals browser passwords, cookies, payment details, crypto wallet data and authentication tokens, and uses AI to pick high-value victims.

author: kevalcodes
text:
🚨 The PolinRider supply-chain attack targets GitHub & npm. 
It hijacks dev accounts & injects loaders into Tailwind & Next config files. 
Run scans, audit PRs, & rotate tokens now!

author: WhaleScan
text: Hackers sent fake nuclear strike warnings through emergency alert apps in Russia and Ukraine, hours apart.

author: audiee_ai
text: Trigger.dev (platform for durable AI agents and workflows) says an attacker got environment variables from some customer organizations. Those variables likely hold model/AI provider and database keys. Rotate them today, even if no email came.

author: stretchcloud
text: https://t.co/J2QZnTUBvF disclosed Sunday that an attacker got into environment variables for a subset of its organizations. The company builds infrastructure for durable AI agents and workflows, meaning what got touched sits underneath other people's agents: API keys, webhook https://t.co/omxUgtx8Np

text: AI in short: Full account takeover in ChatGPT HTML previews, chained through MathLive's virtual keyboard. $5,000 bounty. Brazilian court sanctions lawyers for prompt injection in a court filing.

author: threadlinqs
text: TightVNC Viewer flaw gives pre-auth RCE from a rogue VNC server. PoC is public, and there is no CVE.

author: noelkimx
text: A read-only check that parses SQL can disagree with the database. In one MCP server (CVE-2026-61789), the check read -- as a comment even with no space after it. MySQL needs the space, so a DROP placed after 1--1 ran. An account granted only SELECT can't run that DROP anyway.

author: saintfox_com
text: GitLab CI regex RCE on KEV. LiteLLM forges admin via token replay. Cisco VPN zero day crashes firewalls. SD-WAN controllers steal traffic keys. Three MCP servers run shell from agents.

author: stym_exe
text: Ukraine's Air Alert app was hijacked around 22:47 on Sunday 1 Nov and pushed false radiation, chemical and street-fighting threat alerts for Kyiv for about an hour; hours later Russia's own alert app was hit too.
